reviewer_role: AI-assisted source-and-artifact reviewer; not a qualified nutrition, medical, legal, annotation or independent human-study reviewer.
review_method: Each assigned literal occurrence was manually read in three consecutive index slices, considered with its surrounding paper context, and compared with source code and recorded evidence. Dispositions and individual rationales were authored per unit, not copied from automatic claim-set categories. Symbol/header/container units are explicitly treated as contextual or overlapping units rather than independent experiments.
review_boundaries: The receipt binds the unchanged original index, not the separately corrected final index.
Reproduced identifies numerical/implementation observations supported by this team's recorded checks; this reviewer did not independently rerun every dataset or provider experiment.
Primary-source claims were reviewed against the detailed recorded citation checks; this reviewer did not newly fetch every cited source.
No live providers, training, production changes, clinical judgments, human-participant assessment or submission approval were performed.
Current source-revision public availability was not verified; the parent's exact-revision fetch failed.
Two local historical grouping summaries were inspected and had equal inventory/assignment hashes; complete historical environment records remain unavailable.
